title: What happens when AI agents start paying each other? Watch Mastercard Agent Pay for Machines in action
notes: News brief dated 2026-10-20 (Cloudflare Connect). Says Agent Pay for Machines builds on x402; in the pilot demo a service answers 402 Payment Required through Cloudflare Monetization Gateway, the agent signs an off-chain payment voucher within its approved limit, and providers can combine vouchers and redeem them later. Coinbase Developer Platform provides wallet infrastructure, Base the on-chain settlement network, and BVNK acts as the agent wallet using Mastercard Global Money Platform. Opens AP4M Early Access (first buyer- and seller-side APIs, toolkit, sandbox, documentation) after end-to-end pilots with Cloudflare, Ant International, AIsa, Base, BVNK, Coinbase and Hype. Names no pricing. mastercard.com refuses curl; read on 2026-10-21 in a headed Chrome session. Same page as src-mcap-ap4m-early-access.
